tagline: Naytaste Cheese Stick and savoury snacks from Pamulang with documented export-market intent.

story.title: Naytaste Cheese Stick and savoury snacks from Pamulang with documented export-market intent.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi Tangerang Selatan lists Naytaste Cheese Stick under Amalia in Pamulang. The listing records 5,000 pcs production capacity, export as the target market, and legalities including SPP-IRT, Halal LPPOM MUI, BPOM and HAKI. A BRIN-linked project also lists Dapur Nanay with cheese stick and kentang mustofa.
